evals.name: musk-signal-to-noise
evals.prompt: Make an internal training video for the Pesty team on Elon Musk's 'signal-to-noise ratio' idea - what he means by it and how we should apply it to how we communicate and work.
evals.expected_output: 2-4 min narrated MP4 + srt; hook shows a character drowning in noise; one engine (e.g. a concrete test for whether something is signal); accurate attribution to Musk.
assertions: Video has a narration audio track
Captions run to within 10s of the video's end (in sync)
Storyboard has the four 80/20 acts (hook, concept, engine, takeaway)
Every beat names a concrete visual change (>=5 words)
